papers.title: Accelerating posterior sampling in Bayesian inverse problems with diffusion models: an online-offline perspective
papers.translated_title: 加速贝叶斯逆问题中基于扩散模型的后验采样：在线-离线视角
papers.author: Duc-Lam Duong
papers.summary: Bayesian inverse problems require both informative prior models and computationally feasible posterior inference. Score-based diffusion models provide expressive learned priors, but their use for inversion introduces a conditioning problem: the score of a noised posterior is generally unavailable from a prior score alone. This selective survey reviews the principal approaches to that problem, including likelihood guidance, spectral and projection methods, sequential Monte Carlo corrections, and amortized conditional training. We organize methods by how they split cost between offline preparation and online inference, and compare their assumptions, advantages and limitations, with emphasis on computational speedups. Some ongoing directions and open questions are gathered at the end.
papers.translated_summary: 贝叶斯反问题既需要信息丰富的先验模型，也需要计算上可行的后验推断。基于分数的扩散模型提供了富有表现力的学习先验，但将其用于反演会引入一个条件化问题：含噪后验的分数通常无法仅由先验分数获得。本选择性综述回顾了解决该问题的主要方法，包括似然引导、谱方法与投影方法、序贯蒙特卡洛校正以及摊销条件训练。我们按照方法如何在离线准备与在线推断之间分配成本来组织这些方法，并比较它们的假设、优势与局限，重点在于计算加速。文末汇集了一些进行中的方向和开放问题。

papers.title: Best-of-Both-Worlds FTRL for Linear Bandits: The Interplay of Information Acquisition, Corruption, and Geometry
papers.translated_title: 线性赌博机的最优双世界FTRL：信息获取、腐化与几何的相互作用
papers.author: Canzhe Zhao
papers.summary: We study \textit{best-of-both-worlds} (BOBW) algorithms for linear bandits, which aim to simultaneously guarantee $\gO(\sqrt T)$ regret in the adversarial regime and $\gO(\log T)$ regret in the stochastic regime over $T$ rounds. For finite action sets, we introduce \emph{information-acquisition follow-the-regularized-leader} (\IAFTRL{}), the first BOBW algorithm based purely on the follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) framework that attains an $\gO(\cstar\log T)$-type regret in the stochastic regime, where $\cstar$ is the information-acquisition complexity that characterizes instance-dependent optimality in linear bandits, while retaining the $\gO(\sqrt{T})$ regret guarantee in the adversarial regime. This resolves the open problem posed in~\cite{LeeEtAl2021,KongZ023,ItoT23,ZhaoItoLi2025}.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究线性赌博机的最优双世界（BOBW）算法，其目标是在T轮中同时保证对抗性情形下的$\gO(\sqrt T)$遗憾和随机性情形下的$\gO(\log T)$遗憾。对于有限动作集，我们引入信息获取跟随正则化领导者（IAFTRL），这是首个完全基于跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）框架的BOBW算法，在随机性情形下达到$\gO(\cstar\log T)$型遗憾，其中$\cstar$是信息获取复杂度，刻画了线性赌博机中依赖于实例的最优性，同时在对抗性情形下保持$\gO(\sqrt{T})$遗憾保证。这解决了文献\cite{LeeEtAl2021,KongZ023,ItoT23,ZhaoItoLi2025}中提出的开放问题。

papers.title: [Re] Pure Noise to the Rescue of Insufficient Data
papers.author: Seungjae Ryan Lee
papers.summary: We examine the main claims of Zada, Benou, and Irani (2021), which states that in an image classification task with imbalanced training data, (i) using pure noise to augment minority-class images encourages generalization by improving minority-class accuracy. This method is paired with (ii) a new batch normalization layer that normalizes noise images using affine parameters learned from natural images, which improves the model's performance. Moreover, (iii) this improvement is robust to varying levels of data augmentation. Finally, the authors propose that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification even on balanced training data. We implemented the training pipeline from the description of the paper using PyTorch and integrated authors' code snippets for sampling pure noise images and batch normalizing noise and natural images separately. We reproduced the main claims that (i) oversampling with pure noise improves generalization by improving the minority-class accuracy, (ii) the proposed batch normalization (BN) method outperforms baselines, (iii) and this improvement is robust across data augmentations. Our results also support that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification on balanced training data. However, additional experiments suggest that the performance improvement from OPeN may be more orthogonal to the improvement caused by a bigger network or more complex data augmentation.
papers.translated_summary: 我们考察Zada、Benou和Irani（2021）的主要主张，该文指出，在训练数据不平衡的图像分类任务中，（i）使用纯噪声增强少数类图像，通过提高少数类准确率来促进泛化。该方法与（ii）一种新的批归一化层相结合，该层使用从自然图像学到的仿射参数对噪声图像进行归一化，从而提升模型性能。此外，（iii）这种改进对不同水平的数据增强具有鲁棒性。最后，作者提出（iv）添加纯噪声图像甚至可以在平衡训练数据上改善分类。我们根据论文描述使用PyTorch实现了训练流程，并整合了作者用于采样纯噪声图像以及分别对噪声和自然图像进行批归一化的代码片段。我们复现了主要主张：（i）使用纯噪声进行过采样通过提高少数类准确率来改善泛化，（ii）所提出的批归一化（BN）方法优于基线，（iii）且这种改进在不同数据增强下具有鲁棒性。我们的结果也支持（iv）添加纯噪声图像可以在平衡训练数据上改善分类。然而，额外实验表明，OPeN带来的性能提升可能与更大网络或更复杂数据增强所带来的提升更为正交。

papers.title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
papers.translated_title: LLM小说中角色名称集中度：测量位移与缓解重复
papers.author: Alejandro Mozo Quesada
papers.summary: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.
papers.translated_summary: 大语言模型小说中的人物名字集中在少数反复出现的名字上，如“Elara”和“Elias”，这是AI生成劣质内容的一个可测量表征。现有修复方法要么需要logit访问权限或重新训练，要么按请求逐一操作而无法控制整个语料库中的集中度。提示层面的策略能在多大程度上降低集中度，以及对名字自然度造成何种代价，尚未得到系统测量。我们提出一项跨八种策略的名字集中度控制实证研究，并引入推测性命名——一种无需微调的方法，将推测性解码的草稿-验证-拒绝范式从token适配到名字。该方法通过言语化采样请求候选名字集，对照一个结合了每模型指纹与运行时计数器的SlopTracker进行评分，并通过温度控制规则或其严格变体（HARD）进行选择。我们使用20个大语言模型，从文本和视觉刺激生成四种语言的44,782篇故事（88,919个具名角色），并用无列表碰撞指标（Slop Ratio，SR）测量集中度，将其分解为已知成分和涌现成分。基于列表的策略无法消除劣质内容：静态禁用列表将集中度转移至涌现名字，并使已证实的真实名字占比减少一半以上。推测性命名则能消除它：仅采样脚手架平均将SR降低89%，动态追踪器使总降幅达到95%，平均碰撞概率从7.3%降至0.4%，已知名字碰撞保持为零，同时自然度接近基线（按语言42-69%已证实），故事内碰撞从4.3%降至0.2%。该策略排名在语言、模型家族和名字计数惯例之间保持稳定。因此，名字集中度可在语料库层面控制，无需logit访问或重新训练；命名之外的更广泛创意多样性仍有待探索。

papers.title: DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.translated_title: DriftingPlanner：面向端到端自动驾驶中一步轨迹规划的漂移生成模型
papers.author: Ziming Liu
papers.summary: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.
papers.translated_summary: 端到端规划器通过坐标回归或扩散与流匹配来解码自车轨迹。坐标回归速度快，但会将可能的机动混合成一条可能不遵循任何机动的轨迹；扩散与流匹配则对轨迹分布建模，但需要多次推理步骤。漂移模型将这一迭代过程移入训练阶段：一步生成器学习在生成样本与真实样本之间遵循吸引—排斥场。漂移方法最初为类别条件图像生成而提出，其中每个类别提供大量正样本。在规划中，每个场景本身就是自己的条件。将场景池化会使一个场景生成的轨迹被吸引到不相关场景的真实轨迹上，而按场景计算场则只留下一个正样本，即专家轨迹。相互排斥随后将生成的轨迹保持在其周围的一个壳层上，因此任何单条生成轨迹都会偏离真实轨迹。我们提出 DriftingPlanner，一种仅用漂移损失训练、不含任何坐标回归项的轨迹规划器。它按场景计算场，并在推理时移除壳层：在一次批处理中同时解码每个噪声向量及其相反向量，对每个对偶对取平均可抵消来自壳层中心的位移的线性部分。在 NAVSIM navtest 上，DriftingPlanner 达到最先进的 93.75 PDMS，且在单步推理下，其漂移解码器与最佳扩散或流匹配设置仅差 0.13 PDMS，而后者需要十步推理。

papers.title: OntoDoc: Automatically Generating Ontology Resource Descriptions
papers.translated_title: OntoDoc：自动生成本体资源描述
papers.author: Juan Guajardo Gutierrez
papers.summary: Knowledge graphs and ontologies form the backbone of structured, machine-readable knowledge representation, yet ontology terms often lack natural language descriptions, limiting their accessibility and reuse. Existing ontology verbalization approaches tend to rely on rule-based or template-driven techniques that operate on strict, formal schema axioms, resulting in rigid verbalizations that fail to convey richer contextual semantics. We present OntoDoc, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating natural language descriptions for any Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) within a SPARQL endpoint or RDF file. OntoDoc operates through a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Database Context agent that adaptively explores the knowledge graph via SPARQL to collect semantically informative triples about the target IRI; (2) a Web Context agent that retrieves and re-ranks encyclopedic background knowledge from Wikipedia and the open web; (3) an Assumption Generation agent that synthesizes both contexts into a structured, evidence-grounded list of intermediate assumptions; and (4) a Description Generation agent that produces the final natural language description from the grounded assumptions. We evaluate OntoDoc on three knowledge graphs spanning biomedical, agricultural, and cross-domain settings, using both automatic scoring via Large Language Models (LLMs) and human evaluation with 11 annotators. OntoDoc consistently matches or exceeds a naive LLM baseline and a template-based ontology verbalizer in accuracy. Furthermore, it vastly outperforms both baselines in the completeness of the generated descriptions, delivering an average 12% improvement in completeness over the naive baseline across all domains, and improving completeness scores by as much as 2.8 points on a 5-point scale relative to the ontology verbalizer.
papers.translated_summary: 知识图谱和本体构成了结构化、机器可读的知识表示 backbone，然而本体术语往往缺乏自然语言描述，限制了其可访问性和复用性。现有的本体语言化方法倾向于依赖基于规则或模板驱动的技术，这些技术作用于严格的形式化模式公理，导致语言化结果僵化，无法传达更丰富的上下文语义。我们提出 OntoDoc，一个多智能体框架，用于为 SPARQL 端点或 RDF 文件中的任意国际化资源标识符（IRI）自动生成自然语言描述。OntoDoc 通过四阶段流水线运行：（1）数据库上下文智能体，通过 SPARQL 自适应地探索知识图谱，以收集关于目标 IRI 的语义信息丰富的三元组；（2）网络上下文智能体，从 Wikipedia 和开放网络中检索并重排百科背景知识；（3）假设生成智能体，将两种上下文综合为结构化的、有证据支撑的中间假设列表；（4）描述生成智能体，从有依据的假设中生成最终的自然语言描述。我们在涵盖生物医学、农业和跨领域设置的三个知识图谱上评估 OntoDoc，使用通过大语言模型（LLM）进行的自动评分以及由 11 名标注者进行的人工评估。OntoDoc 在准确性上始终匹配或超过朴素 LLM 基线和基于模板的本体语言化器。此外，它在生成描述的完整性上大幅优于两个基线，在所有领域中相对于朴素基线平均提升 12% 的完整性，并且相对于本体语言化器在 5 分制上完整性分数提升高达 2.8 分。

papers.title: Geometry of Confabulation and Refusal in Small Language Models
papers.translated_title: 小语言模型中虚构与拒绝的几何结构
papers.author: Vladimir Kazei
papers.summary: Faced with an unanswerable question, small language models can either refuse or confabulate: confidently produce a wrong answer. Can the hidden state before the first generated token provide a clue? Can we flip confabulations into refusals? I introduce ConfabQA, a 784-item benchmark whose obscure-pre-cutoff category breaks the typical correctness/knowledge-cutoff confound and map the geometry of the hidden state with linear probes, a sparse autoencoder (SAE), and direct optimization of intervention directions. On Qwen3-1.7B and Gemma 2 2B the probe separates upcoming refusals from confabulations well beyond prompt features (+7.4/+16.3 pp); on Llama 3.2 3B the ConfabQA margin is within fold-to-fold spread, but a direct refusal probe on PopQA and TriviaQA recovers +18-25 pp. On Qwen I closely inspect three candidate directions for the refusal vector: probe-recovered, Qwen-Scope SAE feature, and directly optimized. Although the three directions are pairwise 50-81 degrees apart, a push at or below the state's own norm along any of them flips most confabulations into refusal openings dominated by the "As..." family. Forcing the opener without touching the hidden state yields the same one-in-three judged-refusal rate as any push. The opposite push collapses refusals mostly into confabulations, yet leaves originally correct answers intact, so the direction gates the opening speech act rather than the knowledge behind it. Confabulations do not resolve into a concentrated feature in a dictionary or a token signature on Qwen3-1.7B. Scoring every probe on the margin over the strongest of four prompt-feature baselines extracts the hidden state's own contribution. Correctness signal is model-dependent and portable only for Llama 3.2 3B: 81% of the probe's margin over test majority survives transfer between ConfabQA, PopQA, and TriviaQA. Benchmark, judge, and code are released.
papers.translated_summary: 面对一个无法回答的问题，小型语言模型要么拒绝回答，要么虚构：自信地给出错误答案。第一个生成 token 之前的隐藏状态能否提供线索？我们能否将虚构翻转为拒绝？我引入了 ConfabQA，一个包含 784 个条目的基准，其 obscure-pre-cutoff 类别打破了典型的正确性/知识截止混淆，并用线性探针、稀疏自编码器（SAE）以及干预方向的直接优化来刻画隐藏状态的几何结构。在 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Gemma 2 2B 上，探针将即将发生的拒绝与虚构区分开来，效果远超提示特征（+7.4/+16.3 个百分点）；在 Llama 3.2 3B 上，ConfabQA 的裕度在折间波动范围内，但在 PopQA 和 TriviaQA 上的直接拒绝探针恢复了 +18-25 个百分点。在 Qwen 上，我仔细检查了拒绝向量的三个候选方向：探针恢复的方向、Qwen-Scope SAE 特征以及直接优化的方向。尽管这三个方向两两相距 50-81 度，但沿其中任一方向以等于或低于状态自身范数的幅度推动，都能将大多数虚构翻转为以“As...”家族为主的拒绝开头。在不触及隐藏状态的情况下强制该开头，与任何推动产生相同的三分之一判定拒绝率。反向推动则将拒绝大多坍缩为虚构，但原本正确的答案保持不变，因此该方向门控的是开头言语行为，而非其背后的知识。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，虚构并未在字典中解析为集中的特征或 token 签名。在四个提示特征基线中最强者的裕度上对每个探针评分，可提取隐藏状态自身的贡献。正确性信号依赖于模型，且仅对 Llama 3.2 3B 可移植：探针相对于测试多数类的裕度中有 81% 在 ConfabQA、PopQA 和 TriviaQA 之间的迁移中得以保留。基准、评判器和代码均已发布。

papers.title: Learning momenta for Hamiltonian-based models
papers.translated_title: 学习基于哈密顿量模型中的动量
papers.author: Ignacio Puiggros T.
papers.summary: There has been increasing interest in methodologies that incorporate physics priors into neural network architectures to enhance their modeling capabilities. Among these methodologies, Hamiltonian neural networks (HNNs) and their variants have gained considerable attention. These architectures explicitly encode Hamiltonian mechanics both in their structure and loss function, resulting in desirable properties and additional modeled information. A crucial limitation of HNNs is their reliance on data on the target system's generalized momenta. This severely hampers their applicability when the analytical form of the generalized momenta is unknown, which frequently is the case in real-world applications. The goal of the present work is to develop a general extension of Hamiltonian-based architectures that addresses this issue by simultaneously learning the system's generalized momenta, Hamiltonian structure, and dynamics from data. The proposed architecture learns the generalized momenta when their analytical form is unknown, and only (potentially non-sequential) data on the state and its derivatives is available. A dissipative mass-spring system, a double pendulum, and a rolling disk under nonholonomic constraints are considered as canonical examples to assess the performance of the proposed architecture.
papers.translated_summary: 将物理先验融入神经网络架构以增强其建模能力的方法日益受到关注。在这些方法中，哈密顿神经网络及其变体获得了相当多的关注。这些架构在结构和损失函数中显式地编码哈密顿力学，从而产生理想的性质和额外的建模信息。哈密顿神经网络的一个关键局限在于其依赖目标系统广义动量的数据。当广义动量的解析形式未知时，这严重阻碍了其适用性，而这在实际应用中经常出现。本工作的目标是开发一种基于哈密顿的架构的一般性扩展，通过同时从数据中学习系统的广义动量、哈密顿结构和动力学来解决这一问题。所提出的架构在广义动量的解析形式未知、且仅有关于状态及其导数（可能非序列）的数据时学习广义动量。以耗散质量-弹簧系统、双摆以及非完整约束下的滚动圆盘作为典型示例，评估所提出架构的性能。

papers.title: EZ-Ar-VC: Robust Arabic Voice Anonymization with Generalization across Dialects and Code-Switching
papers.translated_title: EZ-Ar-VC：面向方言与语码转换泛化的稳健阿拉伯语语音匿名化
papers.author: Injy Hamed
papers.summary: Voice conversion (VC) models can be used to anonymize speech data while preserving naturalness. Existing models, however, are mainly optimized for English and other high-resource languages, and they fail to generalize well to Arabic due to its distinct phonology. In this work, we comprehensively evaluate existing zero-shot VC systems for Arabic speech, identifying limitations in pronunciation preservation. We then train an Arabic-centric model based on EZ-VC on diverse Arabic speech, and demonstrate strong performance in intelligibility, naturalness, and pronunciation preservation, while maintaining high speaker dissimilarity. Through subjective evaluation, we further demonstrate its robustness to code-switching and cross-dialectal conversion, as well as its generalization to Arabic dialects with limited representation in the training data. Our findings highlight the limitations of zero-shot VC and the importance of target-language adaptation for robust voice anonymization.
papers.translated_summary: 语音转换（VC）模型可用于在保持自然度的同时匿名化语音数据。然而，现有模型主要针对英语和其他高资源语言进行优化，由于阿拉伯语独特的音系特征，这些模型难以很好地泛化到阿拉伯语。在本工作中，我们全面评估了现有的零样本VC系统在阿拉伯语语音上的表现，识别出其在发音保持方面的局限性。随后，我们在多样化的阿拉伯语语音上训练了一个基于EZ-VC的阿拉伯语中心模型，并展示了其在可懂度、自然度和发音保持方面的强劲性能，同时保持了较高的说话人差异性。通过主观评估，我们进一步证明了该模型对语码转换和跨方言转换的鲁棒性，以及其对训练数据中代表性有限的阿拉伯语方言的泛化能力。我们的发现凸显了零样本VC的局限性以及目标语言适配对于鲁棒语音匿名化的重要性。

papers.title: Toward Bounding Coding-Agent Autonomy in Software Maintenance: A Pilot Study of Boundary Contracts
papers.translated_title: 面向软件维护中编码智能体自主性的边界约束：边界契约的初步研究
papers.author: Heeyong Eun
papers.summary: As coding agents gain greater autonomy to modify software repositories, relevant context alone does not define their operational authority. An artifact may be relevant to a maintenance task while being inappropriate to edit; conversely, another artifact may be required even when it is not explicitly mentioned in the request. We explore Boundary Contracts, a machine-readable abstraction that makes task-specific artifact roles (editable, inspect-only, required, and protected) explicit before repository modification begins. We conduct a pilot study on 40 maintenance tasks from a real enterprise repository, comparing the same Codex-based coding agent with and without Boundary Contract information. The boundary-informed condition improves macro edit-selection F1 from 0.440 to 0.682, required-behavior coverage from 0.429 to 0.673, and the number of strictly acceptable patches from 9 of 40 to 18 of 40. To probe whether these gains are explained only by improved file localization, we additionally analyze 21 tasks in which both conditions modify at least one identical file. Differences remain in edit selectivity and patch outcomes, providing initial evidence that explicit artifact roles may influence maintenance behavior beyond localization alone. This pilot does not establish the general effectiveness of Boundary Contracts. Rather, it provides initial evidence for a broader research question: how should the operational boundaries of coding agents be generated, validated, revised, and ultimately enforced as repository-level maintenance becomes increasingly autonomous?
papers.translated_summary: 随着编码代理获得更大的自主权来修改软件仓库，仅凭相关上下文并不能界定其操作权限。某个工件可能与维护任务相关，却不适合被编辑；反过来，另一个工件可能即使请求中未明确提及，也是必需的。我们探索了边界契约（Boundary Contracts），这是一种机器可读的抽象，可在仓库修改开始之前明确任务特定的工件角色（可编辑、仅检查、必需和受保护）。我们针对来自真实企业仓库的40个维护任务开展了一项试点研究，将同一个基于Codex的编码代理在有和没有边界契约信息的情况下进行比较。有边界信息的条件将宏编辑选择F1从0.440提升至0.682，必需行为覆盖率从0.429提升至0.673，严格可接受补丁的数量从40个中的9个提升至40个中的18个。为探究这些增益是否仅由文件定位改善所解释，我们额外分析了21个任务，在这些任务中两种条件都至少修改了一个相同的文件。编辑选择性和补丁结果方面仍存在差异，这提供了初步证据，表明明确的工件角色可能影响维护行为，而不仅仅是定位。本试点并未确立边界契约的普遍有效性。相反，它为一个更广泛的研究问题提供了初步证据：随着仓库级维护变得越来越自主，编码代理的操作边界应如何生成、验证、修订并最终强制执行？
